caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a pink-swirled naruto fish cake. Served in a white bowl with black calligraphy, it rests on a dark, reflective surface under soft, even lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark, smooth, matte surface with subtle reflections and faint, indistinct markings near the bowl's edge.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with glossy surface and irregular, slightly curled edges.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles, green onions, and a pink swirl garnish.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a glossy surface and irregular, segmented shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with black calligraphy, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle inner curve.
Naruto fish cake: pale yellow, smooth, round with pink spiral swirl on top, slightly glossy surface.
